inspection.reviewer: Codex root + browser_recon + recovery_ledger + product_recon; recovery: Codex product_recon
inspection.reviewMethod: 102 final PNGs individually inspected with view_image; 96 inherited only after exact SHA-256 equality to the preserved reviewed PNGs. Recovery extension: 24 freshly inspected and 0 inherited only after exact SHA-256 equality to actually reviewed PNGs.
fixesApplied: Two light-theme primary-button selectors now exclude disabled controls, preserving the disabled muted foreground.
Final game dialog/tutorial disabled states inspected; four held-I/O setup-state captures are recorded separately in reports/s112-disabled-primary-after.json.
limitations: Synthetic states prove rendering, not gameplay semantics.
Byte equality carries prior pixel inspection, not prior source authority.
Automated contrast samples do not cover every application pixel.
All 24 assigned images were freshly inspected with view_image; no exact-byte inherited reviews were used.
Simulation-running and simulation-interrupted captures are synthetic status rendering fixtures in the real browser, not proof of simulation job behavior.
Pixel inspection checks visible layout, text, and recovery controls; it does not measure contrast ratios or replace interaction tests.
Recovery simulation notices are synthetic rendering states, not evidence that background jobs execute correctly.
